title: Does CNG damage the engine?
youtube_title: Does CNG damage the car engine? Myth vs fact

slides.heading: Factory-fitted CNG is built for it
Use a factory or approved kit

voice_lines: A factory-fitted CNG car has an engine tuned for it, and it's covered by warranty. Badly fitted cheap kits are where problems start.
What you give up is some power, which you'll feel on climbs, and boot space for the cylinder. What you gain is a much lower running cost.
Keep some petrol in the tank, get the spark plugs checked more often, and get the cylinder tested every three years.
So no, CNG doesn't damage a properly fitted, well serviced engine. Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram.
caption:
Does CNG damage the engine? Short answer: not when it's factory-fitted or an approved kit, and serviced on time ⛽

✅ Factory CNG: engine tuned for it, warranty covered
❌ Cheap, badly tuned aftermarket kits: that's where trouble starts

Trade-offs: a little less power on climbs and less boot space, for a much lower running cost.

Care tips: keep some petrol in the tank, check spark plugs more often, and get the cylinder tested every 3 years.

Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram 👇
